So the appropriate crime is "行贿". However there is also "受贿" for the officials receiving bribes, but the defendant is the briber, not the recipient. So we label "行贿". Also maybe "受贿" for the officials, but we only label crimes of the defendant. So answer: [罪名]行贿<eoa>.
